system.notes: A hold-out pistol at one-half range (round down), −1 Damage (4L → 3L) and +1 recoil (sr2e weapons: Streetline Special ca17afcb8c61ee53 (hold-out pistol), system 0.109.0). The +1 recoil is MANUAL (the system has no positive recoil field). One shot; reload 10 Combat Turns (a Biotech Test cuts it by half the character's Quickness). Rounds cost ×5. Special Skill or Quickness Test; no aim enhancers. Firing damages the cybereye (Cyberware Rules p.46). After firing: +2 to visual tests for (6 − unaugmented Body) Combat Turns, min 2. Implant weapon: pair with the eye-gun cyberware, which carries the Essence and price; this item costs 0¥. "Special Skill or Quickness Test" (the book): the system rolls its skill field, so set it by hand if your character uses a Special Skill. (Cybertechnology p.22.)
